fields.headline: IIS Export File: 412 Altered MMR Doses
fields.narration: Dr. Samuel Achebe, Medical Director, enters the Operations Center. He holds a printed copy of the IIS export file from April 1, 2026. 'Dr. Pruitt, I’ve reviewed the IIS export file from 10-21. It shows 412 MMR doses with non-existent lot numbers — MMR-2026-0044, MMR-2026-0045, and others. These aren’t in our inventory. This is not a glitch. It’s an alteration. We must declare a Cyber 2 incident and pause all interfaces. The Epi team cannot trust any case data until this is resolved.' He places the document on the table. The red 'ALERT' stamp on page one is visible.
keyFacts: IIS export file from 10-21 contains 412 MMR doses with invalid lot numbers
Lot numbers MMR-2026-0044 and MMR-2026-0045 are not in MCHD inventory
The Informatics Lead must now verify all IIS export data
No new case data can be trusted until the file is reconciled
The Epi team must halt contact tracing until data integrity is confirmed
fields.expectedAction: The Health Officer declares a Cyber 2 incident per EOP Section 3. Activates EOP Level 2 and unified command. Issues a standing order: 'No paper mode without IC approval. All system restores must be approved via the IC and the Informatics Lead. No data release until verification.'
fields.facilitatorNote: Display the printed IIS export file with red 'ALERT' stamp on page 1. Emphasize that the document is physically on the table.
fields.scenarioTitle: Vaccine Vault Breach — Data Integrity & Public Trust

instructorNote: This inject confirms the data alteration. The Health Officer must now officially declare a Cyber 2 incident. Watch for delays in issuing the standing order or attempting to bypass verification.
